posts.text: Amazing program and opportunity! Highly recommend anyone who is interested in SWE or SRE apply. Open to talking about my experience too, if you apply + message me on LinkedIn,

I am excited to announce that between March 18th and 19th, Amanda T., Lecia Cheng, Kevin Lau, and I placed 2nd at MapleHacks in our category Zero Hunger. This hackathon was a challenging one, forcing many of us to reconsider what it really meant to “hack for change”, but over the weekend, our team created nourishNow, a web application that uses machine learning to predict and model demand and cost for the Women Children and Infants (WIC) food program in the United States.
